label: IRQ-YOUNG-SQUASH
title: Squash younger pipeline and transaction state on ordinary irq_taken
model_selection: spawn_agent 省略 model；用户已确认平台默认通道为 gpt-5.6-luna[max]

review.model_selection: spawn_agent 省略 model；用户已确认平台默认通道为 gpt-5.6-luna[max]
review.scope: 只读审查 irq_taken commit 边界、stage/transaction squash 优先级和测试矩阵；只报告阻断风险

scope: 修复普通 irq_taken 在最老 MEM/WB 指令提交 IRQ 边界时未清空年轻 ID/EX、EX/MEM、访存/原子/MMU 和 FP/NEON transaction 状态的问题；保证 IRQ commit 后无年轻 commit、dmem 请求/副作用、FP effect 或旧 token 泄漏。保持 WFI/sys_irq_taken/DAIF/ERET 既有语义，不混入 FIQ、嵌套中断、T-048 operand_c 时序或 T-049 物理验证。

l0: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 compile
l1: 直接 IRQ 注入的 SV/Cocotb 定向测试覆盖 FIFO off/on 与 delay 0/2
覆盖普通 ALU/muldiv、load/store/pair、exclusive/atomic、MMU translation/fault、NEON integer、scalar/NEON FP held response 与 FP/NEON load/store 中代表性同拍边界
断言 IRQ 后年轻 stage valid、dmem accept/write、FP effect 和旧 token 不得泄漏
l2: QEMU strict lockstep 覆盖 base/cache/delay2 的 ASYNC seq、exception packet 与内存副作用；若当前注入接口不足，须交付最小可信矩阵并记录阻断

acceptance: reset/IRQ squash 后所有年轻 stage valid、dmem/atomic/MMU/FP transaction 状态按精确边界清空或隔离；commit_ready=0 时不得 irq_taken；IRQ commit 仅提交边界前最老 MEM/WB，ELR/向量/NZCV/SP 正确；同拍及之后无年轻 commit、请求、副作用、FP effect 或旧 token。新增定向测试与受影响 L0-L2 通过；不得关闭断言、跳过差分或修改参考结果。任何新增状态必须说明 reset 值、权限与提交时机。
known_limits: 与远端 T-049 并行但不共享写集；本任务不得运行 Quartus、修改 QSF/SDC 或使用 T-049 probe
不处理 FIQ、nested IRQ、DAIF/sys_irq_taken/WFI 语义扩展；发现独立问题另行登记
不得修改 QEMU fork；只读复用已校验 QEMU binary/plugin
2026-09-04 final review 扩写：允许增加独立 MMU abort/quarantine 接口与定向测试；禁止继续复用会清空 TLB 的 tlb_invalidate 作为普通 IRQ kill

integrator_review.notes: Rework final review found no code/test blockers. Integrator reran compile, MMU, IRQ FIFO/delay matrix, rebuilt lockstep, hard_irq 30/30, NEON FP 48/48 and registry consistency on the combined T-051 + T-052 SHA; all passed. Natural CASP/STXR/DC ZVA IRQ overlap remains a follow-up test gap.

next: 集成后复跑受影响 L0-L2；后续物理候选需包含本修复并重新确认时序

blockers: Accepted younger store/atomic/cache write side effects cannot be rolled back; IRQ must delay/drain them exactly once while only unaccepted requests may be squashed
MMU translation/fault and delayed memory responses require explicit priority or quarantine so stale completions cannot poison the IRQ vector
Muldiv has no kill port and must drain safely or require an explicitly approved write-set expansion
The oldest MEM/WB FP effect must survive the IRQ commit while younger FP/NEON transactions are killed
Raw IRQ fencing must preserve commit_ready backpressure and FIFO on/off forward progress

final_review.code_blockers: irq_taken cannot reuse tlb_invalidate: it clears architectural TLB state and can strand an accepted PTW response, deadlocking the MMU/memory arbiter
final_review.test_blockers: direct TB uses synthetic commit_fire for some cases and lacks natural MEM/WB plus PTW/atomic/CASP/STXR/DC ZVA IRQ overlap
final_review.required_fix: add a dedicated TLB-preserving MMU abort/quarantine path that blocks same-edge PTW issue, drains/discards any accepted old PTW response, then permits vector translation; add natural overlap tests and repair handoff/evidence SHA chain

rework_final_review.known_limits: Synthetic older MEM/WB remains in some direct cases; natural CASP/STXR/DC ZVA IRQ overlap remains a separate regression task.
